title: Exact general roots of unity
objective: Implement a bounded replayable exact roots-of-unity producer for higher-degree totally imaginary number fields, completing cyclotomic quartic class/unit computations without polynomial allowlists

oracles: PARI nfrootsof1 and pinned Hecke torsion_units_gen_order

handoff.summary: Adds a general exact roots-of-unity producer with a universal phi exponent, certified residue-field upper bounds, deterministic generators, bounded embedding-box exhaustion, and authenticated replayable certificates. Exact completion now covers cyclotomic and translated quartics, including class/unit completion for x^4 + 1, while retaining real-place and imaginary-quadratic behavior. Focused tests, strict Python, the full native suite, and a production/fallback benchmark pass.
risks: The class-group branch's number-field-global-arithmetic lazy bundle is 1,409,552 bytes after this source change, 9,552 bytes above its integration-owned 1,400,000-byte budget; the integration lane approved raising that narrow budget to 1,420,000 and must rerun architecture:check after cherry-pick.

Exact embedding-box exhaustion is deliberately capped and can return an honest incomplete result for fields whose certified coordinate box exceeds max_candidates; residue-field certification is the normal fast path.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this commit into class-group, raise only number-field-global-arithmetic's lazy budget from 1,400,000 to 1,420,000, and rerun pnpm architecture:check.
Use the certificate payload and roots benchmark when profiling higher-degree class/unit completion; do not promote capped fallback results to complete.
